content:
The **Helvetia Post Office and Store** is a building within the Appalachian town of Helvetia.

Located on Pickens Road in the center of town, it is a two-story tall building combining a small post office and a store. Upon entering, there is a small sitting area to the left with mailboxes at the back wall. To the south is a Picklock skill 2-locked door, which leads into a small storage room with a desk and two large shelves. To the west is a large store with lots of shelves, a Nuka-Cola Machine, two Cash Registers on the counter and a Picklock skill 1-locked Safe behind it. The stairs lead up to the second floor.

The second floor consists of a sitting area to the north, with a door leading onto a balcony. A side room on the eastern wall has a Cooler, while a restroom to the south contains a First Aid kit on the sink.

A small workshop with a Weapons Workbench is located directly east of the main building.

The Helvetia Post Office and Store appears in *Fallout 76*.
